verdict.rationale: mise's own CI docs say mise-action installs the declared tools and caches them by default, which gives a first-party cache setup for CI. Nothing in the pack documents offline installs: lockfiles with `mise install --locked` provide reproducibility, which is not offline capability. missing for 10: documented offline/air-gapped install mode, explicit cache-restore configuration details (cache keys, paths, non-GitHub CI), independent evidence of CI speedups.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can make CI installs fast with a documented cache-restore setup and offline-capable installs

citations.quote: mise-action installs mise and the tools declared in the checked-out repository. By default it also caches the tools
we provide a mise-action that wraps the installation of mise and the tools
